title: Anatomy atlas (AI draft by Horalix)
description: Whole-anatomy outlines for the Learn-mode anatomy layer (layer 'atlas'): AI drafts by Horalix on every CT series and every frontal chest radiograph of the body, chest-pairs, ct-mri-pairs, expansion, more-ct-xr, neuro-msk, starter packs, after automatic QC. Not reviewed by a radiologist; never used for grading. No images: targets reference those packs' series and SOP UIDs.
